missed_facts.fact: Customer Service receives about 6,000 PO emails per week
Order Creation Service writes drafts to Azure Cosmos DB

invented_claims.claim: Protect PO email content as Confidential and mask PII in logs

security_compliance: Explicit MFA verification and tests for MFA flows (documented requirement in reference).
CSRF and XSS-specific tests called out (UI/API protections).
Explicit spoofed sender-domain tests to ensure spoofing cannot auto-trust a customer.
Explicit prompt-injection tests for text in emails to ensure AI components cannot be manipulated.
Explicit JWT/session timeout values and token expiry tests (reference listed session timeout/token expiration specifics).
nfr_reliability: Explicit backup/restore testing and verification of restore behavior.
Data reconciliation tests and verification after recovery (reconcile Cosmos DB/SAP/Blob states).
Documented runbooks and exact retry/backoff policies tied to tests (reference expects runbooks & alerting).
nfr_accessibility_compat: Full accessibility/WCAG conformance tests (screen reader labels, focus order, ARIA attributes).
Zoom/reflow and high-contrast mode verification and detailed error identification guidance.
Explicit supported browser version matrix (enterprise-supported Edge/Chrome/Firefox versions).
observability_audit: Explicit capture of 'extraction/model/prompt version' in audit records/logs (extraction version).
Explicit audit trail entries for CSR corrections and release actions (who changed what and when).
Clear verification of access controls for audit/export and retention policy enforcement in tests.
